scope: One primary field per existing identity. Classification neither grants mastery nor changes runtime domains, prerequisites or historical maturity. Names are not added discoveries.
classification_notes: A primary field reflects the main taught mechanism or operating application, not every system that consumes its output. Cross-field dependencies retain their existing edges.
Military-specific care and logistics remain D20; broadly usable ships and flight mechanisms belong to D10/D11 even when runtime domains call them security.
Component electronics belong to D21; communications coding and network practice belong to D13. Optical measurement instruments and general physical models belong to D12.
Wood, minerals and feedstock preparation belong to D04; producing fuels belongs to D05; mechanisms and machine tooling belong to D06. Application-specific running gear remains D09.

Existing broad discoveries remain counted once. If later expansion splits a broad mechanism, explicitly retire or narrow the earlier identity and reconcile saves rather than count an umbrella plus equivalent children.
Assignments are editorial proposals for review. A runtime signal domain is not an era, field quota or universal civilization level. Historical horizon allocation remains outstanding.
